title.narrative: Chocó Alert: Early Humanitarian Action related to the Winter/Heavy Rains Emergency

description.narrative: The project will carry out anticipatory activities to save lives in seven (7) municipalities of Choco, Colombia some of which have already been affected by heavy rains. The following activities have been chosen for their relevance as both anticipatory and early response measures. The project focuses primarily on the advance delivery of: (1) Water, Sanitation and Hygiene (WASH): Water purification tablets for 1,400 households, of which 687 were donated and 713 will be purchased by the project. (2) Protection: the delivery of first aid kits and important awareness messages on the risks associated with flooding and landslides caused by heavy rains, as well as the relevant services available through awareness campaigns in all seven municipalities. (3) Food security: food for 1,400 families. Within these seven prioritised municipalities in Chocó, we will focus on the most vulnerable indigenous and Afro-Colombian households, including pregnant and lactating women, older adults, and children, who could be left without access to medical services or adequate food for at least two weeks. The decision to prioritise preventive food assistance is based on the fact that daily livelihoods depend on subsistence crops, which will be affected by the expected winter wave.
